source.title: Jelang Konser di Jakarta, Eric Chou Ungkap Album Baru dan Keinginan Kolaborasi dengan Rich Brian
source.description:
Eric Chou Portrait

Eric Chou appears in a formal black blazer over a white shirt, accessorized with a silver pendant necklace. His hair is neatly styled, and he gazes directly at the camera with a calm, confident expression against a simple light background.

This image complements an announcement that the Taiwanese singer-songwriter will perform at Arena Indonesia in Jakarta on May 9, 2026. He revealed plans to release a new album on March 10, 2026, blending R&B elements with his trademark ballads. Chou also shared his desire to collaborate with Indonesian artists Rich Brian and NIKI, drawing on musical inspirations from his boarding school

source.title: 周興哲MV破天荒合體！揪來陳意涵、傅孟柏深情主演｜東森娛樂
source.description:
Eric Chou Promotional Portrait

Eric Chou stands against a deep red backdrop, wearing a tailored black blazer and a bold silver chain necklace. His composed expression and minimalist styling convey a modern, sophisticated image befitting the release of his tenth anniversary album.

The album "Almost 幾乎是愛情" centers on stories of love that are just out of reach. Its lead single "想念你想我" premiered with a cinematic MV starring Chen Yi-han and Fu Meng-po, directed by Lin Xiao-qian. The video’s narrative unfolds in a cooking class, exploring themes of longing and the bittersweet nature of almost-love, marking a milestone in Chou’s decade-long career

source.title: 周興哲出道12年自爆靈感枯竭　新歌遭退件3次「靠東京一台琴」神救援 | 中天新聞網
source.description:
Eric Chou’s Reflective Portrait

Eric Chou stands confidently in a black leather jacket and pinstriped pants, set against a dark, minimalist background. His composed expression and modern styling convey both resilience and introspection.

After three rounds of revisions and creative block, Chou found inspiration on a hotel electronic keyboard in Tokyo. The resulting song “Shell,” created for the HBO series “Here’s Jin Lai,” uses the metaphor of past scars as protective shells to express growth and rebirth.
